name: Gevo
outlook:
What Gevo says to expect

  • Full years 2026 and 2027: non-GAAP adjusted EBITDAGevo now expects full year 2026 non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA 1 to be greater than $90 million and 2027 non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA 1 to be greater than $70 million.
  • Full year 2026: carbon business revenueAs announced in October, Gevo expects its carbon business to generate more than $50 million of revenue in 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 10, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
